name: London Tube exploratory connections

projection.operation: Inverse of OSGB36 to WGS 84 (6) + British National Grid (with axis order normalized for visualization)

sources.attribution: Copernicus DEM GLO-90, distributed by Open-Meteo

assumptions: Selected station subset, not the complete Tube system.
No passenger-demand data: station-pair demand is synthetic.
Elevation is visual context only; underground construction cost is not inferred from surface height.
Thames is an OSM centreline; its plotted width is symbolic.
